citation.authors: Izmirly PM, Wan I, Sahl S, Buyon JP et al

cited_by.title: Lupus: symptoms, risk and getting diagnosed early

record.population: Residents of New York County (Manhattan) with lupus, 2007 prevalence and 2007 to 2009 incidence, by race and ethnicity
record.design: Population-based registry (Manhattan Lupus Surveillance Program), capture-recapture analysis
record.finding: Age-standardised prevalence was 62.2 and incidence 4.6 per 100,000 person-years by ACR criteria, about 9 times higher in women than men. Prevalence in non-Hispanic Black women was 210.9 per 100,000 against 64.3 in non-Hispanic white women, 138.3 in Hispanic and 91.2 in non-Hispanic Asian women. Incidence was 15.7 in Black women against 6.5 in white and Hispanic women and 6.6 in Asian women.
record.note: One US county; no data on Black people outside the US. Abstract read; the number of cases is not in it.
